say:0:1028442001:0.text: Although her ideas are a bit strange, she's a very dedicated teacher.
say:0:1028442001:0.source_cn: 她急匆匆地跑掉了……虽然思路有些奇怪，但看起来是很敬业...

say:1:1028442002:0.text: There should be some deer around here.
say:1:1028442002:0.source_cn: 牡鹿和牝鹿，来的路上应该有见到一些……就在这附近找找看吧。
say:1:1028442002:0.male: There should be some deer around here.
say:1:1028442002:0.female: There should be some deer around here.

say:2:1028442003:0.text: When you find one, use the antler flute to attract them to the cabin.
say:2:1028442003:0.source_cn: 等找到了，就吹响鹿笛，把它们吸引到小屋来。
say:2:1028442003:0.male: When you find one, use the antler flute to attract them to the cabin.
say:2:1028442003:0.female: When you find one, use the antler flute to attract them to the cabin.
